// purpose: Warn-only JS type-checking for the frontend (src/). Catches the class of bug that ESLint cannot — e.g. destructuring a property a function never returns, renamed props, typos on object access. Run via `npm run lint:types` (warn) or `lint:types:strict` (enforce). Settings are intentionally permissive (strict off) so it surfaces structural errors, not an implicit-any flood. Tighten over time, then flip the build step to strict.
